entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: An artificial plane of mechanical and biomechanical life made of nine nested spheres, ruled by Yawgmoth and bent on conquering Dominaria.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The recreated Phyrexia that arose on Mirrodin, controlled by five praetors and encompassing all colors of magic.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Thran exile and Phyrexian god who founded Phyresis, ruled Phyrexia from the Ninth Sphere, and was destroyed at the end of the Invasion.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: A planeswalker who brought Yawgmoth to Phyrexia and described its original state.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: The wife of Glacian, who built an infirmary on Phyrexia and later sealed the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: A planeswalker who transfused his being into two halves of a powerstone used to seal the portal at the Caves of Koilos.

entities.name: Gamalgoth
entities.description: The first city of Phyrexia, built from Rebbec's infirmary; its name meant Creature Garden in Thran.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The old home of the Phyrexians, which they planned for millennia to invade and destroy.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Yawgmoth's most trusted Phyrexian demon, sent to scout Dominaria, who built a cult during the Brothers' War and was defeated by Urza.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker and Phyrexia's greatest enemy, who launched the Assault on Phyrexia and the Nine Titans counter-attack and was beheaded by Gerrard.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, compleated by Gix and later tortured in the Seventh Sphere as the Lord of the Wastes' servant.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra, manipulated by Gix, ending with the Golgothian Sylex at Argoth.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A rogue Phyrexian sleeper agent who accompanied Urza and was killed fighting Gix.

entities.name: Ratepe
entities.description: An ally of Urza killed in the battle against Gix at Koilos.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A hero who beat Tsabo Tavoc with Karn, chose to serve Yawgmoth for Hanna's sake, and beheaded Urza.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: The Phyrexian general who led the invasion of Dominaria and was later eaten by Crovax.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: The one who ate the punished Tsabo Tavoc.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on Dominaria in two waves via portal ships and the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: An artificial plane built of flowstone as a staging point for the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The most famous evincar of Rath, one-time blood-brother of Gerrard.

entities.name: Davvol
entities.description: The first known evincar of Rath.

entities.name: Nine Titans
entities.description: The planeswalkers Urza assembled and armed with titan engines to attack Phyrexia.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A planeswalker among the Nine Titans who betrayed and killed Daria and was sealed in a soul bomb by Urza.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: A planeswalker among the Nine Titans, killed by Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A companion of Urza whom Urza was convinced to kill.

entities.name: Legacy Weapon
entities.description: The weapon completed aboard the Weatherlight whose burst of energy destroyed Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship that shot down the Null Moon and was attacked by Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The golem planeswalker who created Mirrodin and unknowingly carried Phyrexian oil there.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Karn's golem guardian of Mirrodin, corrupted by Phyrexian oil.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane created by Karn, where Phyrexia was reborn.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A false god who traveled the multiverse seeking a plane for each color of mana and claimed to find Phyrexia.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: A planeswalker who followed gremlins to Phyrexia in 4074 AR.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: One of the five praetors of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: One of the five praetors of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: One of the five praetors of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: One of the five praetors of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: One of the five praetors of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The biomechanical inhabitants of Phyrexia, grown as newts and compleated into many forms to serve Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Phyresis
entities.description: Yawgmoth's process of replacing weak mortality with artifice and the philosophy of controlled evolution built on it.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The weapon Urza activated to obliterate Argoth.

events.summary: Yawgmoth is brought to Phyrexia by the planeswalker Dyfed, long before the Invasion.
events.quote: Phyrexia was not so different from Mirrodin until Yawgmoth arrived thousands of years ago, brought there by the planeswalker Dyfed.

events.summary: Yawgmoth and the Thran exiles, saved through Phyresis, flee to Phyrexia after being forced out of the Thran Empire; the war destroys the Thran.
events.quote: The ensuing war destroyed the nation of the Thran.

events.summary: Rebbec and Glacian seal the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia at the Caves of Koilos, blocking invasion for five millennia.
events.quote: the planeswalker Glacian transfused his being into two halves of a powerstone that was used by his wife, Rebbec , to seal off the connection

events.summary: Urza and Mishra take the powerstone, accidentally reopening the portal to Phyrexia, and Yawgmoth sends Gix to scout.
events.quote: Seeing his opportunity, Yawgmoth sent through the Phyrexian demon

events.summary: Gix manipulates both sides of the Brothers' War and compleates Mishra.
events.quote: He offered aid and Phyrexian equipment to Mishra, even compleating him.

events.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex, obliterating Argoth and forming the Shard of the Twelve Worlds, which again blocks the Phyrexians.
events.quote: The plans to defeat Urza were foiled when he activated the Golgothian Sylex

events.summary: Urza and Xantcha assault Phyrexia, blasting a hole to the Fourth Sphere before being driven off by Yawgmoth.
events.quote: Urza blasted a giant hole in the plane down to the Fourth Sphere

events.summary: Urza defeats Gix at Koilos with the help of Xantcha and Ratepe, both of whom are killed.
events.quote: both Xantcha and Ratepe were killed

events.summary: Yawgmoth orders the construction of the artificial plane Rath from flowstone as a staging point.
events.quote: Yawgmoth ordered the construction of the artificial plane of Rath through the use of a newly created substance called flowstone

events.summary: Portal ships enter over Benalia and the first wave of the Phyrexian Invasion begins under Tsabo Tavoc.
events.quote: The ships entered Dominaria over the sky of Benalia

events.summary: Tsabo Tavoc is beaten and badly wounded by Gerrard and Karn and retreats to Phyrexia.
events.quote: Tsabo Tavoc had been beaten and badly wounded by Gerrard and Karn and retreated to Phyrexia.

events.summary: The Rathi Overlay begins the second wave, and Tsabo Tavoc is punished and eaten by Crovax.
Urza leads the Nine Titans in a counter-attack on Phyrexia; Tevesh Szat betrays and kills Daria, and Urza kills him, sealing him in a soul bomb.
events.quote: Urza activated the rubrik and killed Szat, sealing him in a Soul bomb

events.summary: Urza is convinced to kill Taysir, then is taken to see Mishra in the Seventh Sphere and brought to worship Yawgmoth in the Ninth.
events.quote: Next, he went to the Ninth Sphere to worship Yawgmoth himself, along with Gerrard.

events.summary: Yawgmoth strips Urza of his planeswalker powers and forces him to fight Gerrard; Gerrard beheads Urza.
events.quote: Gerrard managed to land a strike that beheaded Urza

events.summary: Yawgmoth returns to Dominaria; after the Weatherlight shoots down the Null Moon, the Legacy Weapon destroys him and the Phyrexian forces lose their will to live.
events.quote: Phyrexian forces lost all will to live with the death of their god.

events.summary: Karona the False God claims to have met Teferi and found Phyrexia, a claim later proven false.
events.quote: it is thought that Karona had been delusional

events.summary: Karn's leaked Phyrexian oil corrupts Memnarch and Mirrodin, giving rise to New Phyrexia under five praetors.
events.quote: The five praetors of New Phyrexia now control the plane

events.summary: Karn creates Mirrodin and inadvertently drips Phyrexian oil on it, leaving Memnarch as guardian.
events.quote: he inadvertently dripped a small amount of the corrupting Phyrexian oil on his perfect world
